title: Measured graphify retrieval arm on zonoid code nav corpus evidence chunk 3
summary: CAVEAT (key finding — the misses are a retriever artifact, not a coverage gap): graphify is a LEXICAL-BFS retriever — it seeds the BFS start node by keyword-matching the query against node LABELS, then traverses depth=2. When a common word in the query lexically dominates the real target symbol, it mis-seeds: q10 ("per-PATH lease") seeded on the generic `path` import node -> 3 unrelated path nodes, 78-token near-empty result (the createWorktree/acquireLease chain IS in the graph — q01 surfaced it — BFS just never reached it); q05 ("across TASKS") seeded on `tasks` -> overlay.js, missed costflow.js; q13 seeded on resolveDataDir -> missed embed-providers. So graphify's recall here is gated by seed selection, not by what was indexed. Numbers are a fair out-of-box `--budget 2000` measurement (exactly how an agent would call it).
